description: Check the status of a booking request (preferred times or callback). Returns pending, approved, rejected, counter_proposed, expired, or converted. Needs the manage_token that came back when the request was made.

manage_token.description: manage_token returned with that request_id when the request was created.

request_id.description: request_id returned by request_booking, propose_times or request_callback.

name: get_request_status
title: Check a booking request
